alerts.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 6 at 1:54AM EDT until October 7 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.areas: Hartford; Tolland; Windham; Western Franklin; Eastern Franklin; Northern Worcester; Central Middlesex County; Western Hampshire; Western Hampden; Eastern Hampshire; Eastern Hampden; Western Norfolk; Northern Bristol; Western Plymouth; Southern Bristol; Southern Plymouth; Northwest Middlesex County
alerts.description: * WHAT...Temperatures between 33 and 36 degrees will result in frost formation. * WHERE...Portions of northern Connecticut and central, eastern, southeastern, and western Massachusetts. * WHEN...From 11 PM this evening to 9 AM EDT Wednesday. * IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.
alerts.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.
